“Multi-Week B2B Contracts” means a contract with a school or other educational organization for multiple weeks of classes. All of the figures in the above chart reflect the number of classes and enrollment under Multi-Week B2B Contracts. As a result, the above chart does not reflect information for all classes that each franchised business offered and sold during the respective period.

A franchised business needed to complete the entirety of the semester as of December 31, 2025 in order for that semester’s data to be included in the First Semester of Operations, Second Semester of Operations, or Third Semester of Operations, as applicable. For example, a franchised business that was in the middle of their second semester of operations as of December 31, 2025 had their data for their first semester of operations included in the First Semester of Operations column, but the data for their partially completed second semester of operations was excluded from the Second Semester of Operations column.

“First Semester of Operations” means the first full school semester in which a franchisee establishes two or more Multi-Week B2B Contracts. Semesters typically go from mid-January to June and September to mid-January, but it can vary by school district, city, and state.
“Second Semester of Operations” means the full school semester following the First Semester of Operations, whether in the same school year or the following school year.
“Third Semester of Operations” means the full school semester following the Second Semester of Operations, whether in the same school year or the following school year.
